root_cause: Three migrations applied in the production registry (20261027195341, 20261028090000, 20261028230000) were not recorded in supabase/migration-history.lock.json, so the local-only executable migration check failed on main.

actual_sources: supabase_migrations.schema_migrations on production project, read-only query, 2026-10-28: all three versions present with matching names

fix: Lock entries added for the three production-applied versions. No SQL or runtime change.
prevention_rule: Every executable migration applied in production must be recorded in the migration-history lock in the same change that introduces it.
terminal_rule: Terminal once the integrity test and the controlegroep regression test are green in CI.
